profile.headline: Sr. Security Software Engineer at PeerNova Inc
profile.summary: We are solving some of the most prevalent challenges in the financial industry with deep expertise in blockchain, big data and financial infrastructure.  PeerNova's Cuneiform Platform enables financial institutions to perpetually synchronize their data across multiple internal and external systems guaranteeing data and process integrity.  It simplifies reconciliation, automates exception processing, and provides greater end-to-end operational visibility across workflows in real-time.

positions.title: Sr. Security Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Building real-time friction-less financial markets through Trust and Transparency.
- Achieving data and process integrity by unifying disparate sources of life-cycle events and data in real-time

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Helm is helping people be free, private and secure online by making it easy to take back control of their data.

positions.title: Senior Project Manager
positions.description:
-Mozilla Bridge for Uberproxy, contractor @ Google Inc.
-	For Windows, open-source p11-capi, a PKCS#11 implementation on top of Win32 CAPI + CNG.
-	For Mac OSX, open-source Keychain-Token, a PKCS#11 implementation on top of Apple’s keychains.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Architected, Designed and Developed hybrid TSS (TCG Software Stack) to support TPM 2.0 in addition to TPM 1.2 allowing secure applications to work equally in alll versions of TPM platforms
- Bring the port TrouSerS TSS to production quality with many added new features
- Implemented a Java class to support using Smart Card with an online banking application
- Provided toolkit SDK and support to third-party developers developing TPM secure applications
- Architected, Designed and Developed TPM key backup and restore

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Designed and implementation of a HID (Human Interface Device) parser in C running in FreeDOS environment to support touch screen capability of the Panasonic Toughbook in pre-boot
- Port open-source MUSCLE (Movement for the Use of Smart Cards in a Linux Environment) to FreeDOS environment to allow using Smart Card to unlock SED (Self-Encrypting Drive) during boot

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Design and Implementation of USB keyboard scan and reporting code in Boot loader and EMBASSY OS to support USB Keyboard Smart Card Reader

positions.title: Test Engineer I, II, III, IV
positions.description: Designed and Developed functional test programs in Advantest language to sort NOR and NAND flash devices.
